name: feedback
title: Feedback
description: The response to the player's last act: correct, wrong, score or reward. One component, four variants, from specimen 5d of the design. Correct is a word on a positive plate with a tick, tilted and popping in; wrong the same plate on the surface with a dashed negative ring and a cross, shaking; score the bare +100 floating up beside the stat it changed, no plate; reward a surface card on the reward ring with a star and an Earned kicker, slamming in and staying until tapped. The glyph and the words change colour and text as well as moving, so the answer survives reduced motion, mute and colour blindness alike. Renders synchronously with its props, because the gap between a tap and this element appearing is the library's 100ms budget. Performs nothing: it does not decide whether the last act was right, does not know the running score, and does not settle a reward.
docs: Pass `variant` to say which of the four contract outcomes this is. Pass `label` for the word on the plate (a reward's name); leave it out and a default per variant renders. Pass `message` for the line under it (why an answer was wrong). Pass `delta` for the signed amount a value moved: on `score` it is the whole message, on `correct` it follows the word. Pass `onDismiss` to turn the lifetime on: correct and wrong hold 1200ms and fade, score fades after its float, reward stays until tapped; it is called once the fade has ended. Render one at a time: a new variant or message replaces the plate and plays its entrance again. Place it in the stage's overlay layer, centred, 300px from the top of a phone; score sits beside the stat it changed.
